Perler bead palette conversion - third-party notices

MARD, COCO, Manman, Panpan and Mixiaowo code/HEX reference data:
https://github.com/HansBug/pindou-color-data
Source commit: 178dafbc9e77d3de556550dbd058270200129186
Modified to retain code and HEX fields and derive the MARD 221-color subset.
Panpan and Mixiaowo entries without confirmed codes are excluded.
Duplicate reference colors use a stable representative code during matching.
